The Wee One

Anonymous

 
(From 
Ane Pleasant Garden
 [c. 1800]; edited by C. Kirkpatrick Sharpe)

A 
SLEE
 one, a slee one,

  I neere saw sic a slee one;

The first night that I with him lay,

  Oh, then he got this wee one.

 

This wee one, this wee one,
        5

  This bonny winking wee one;

I’d bin a maid amongst the rest

  Wer’t not I got this wee one.
